Klasse StepOneMoves

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.AbstractMoves
moveCategories.StepOneMoves
public class StepOneMoves extends AbstractMoves
This class is a collection of moves used only in the first step.

These moves are used in the very beginning of the game and for the first step. Different moves in the first step can be useful for different game settings or against different opponents.

The class extends AbstractMoves and therefore has access to the shared game state and helper methods.

  • Methodendetails

    • expandStepOneOriginal

      public String expandStepOneOriginal(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Used usually only in the first step of the game, but could also be used in other steps.

      Distributes the new Fernies and Fernies from the strongest node (which is the only node in step one) to all visible neutral (and owned) nodes, in order to occupy neutral nodes in the early game or to stabilize owned nodes. Placement is done symmetrical around the strongest node. Fallback moves are applied for all previously taken Fernies that were not placed.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the expansion action

    • expandStepOneExtra

      public String expandStepOneExtra(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Used usually only in the first step of the game, but could also be used in other steps.

      Distributes the new Fernies and Fernies from the strongest node in an aggressive way to all visible neutral (and owned) nodes, in order to occupy neutral nodes in the early game or to stabilize owned nodes. Placement is done symmetrical around the strongest node.

      Fallback moves are applied for all previously taken Fernies that were not placed.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the expansion action and a move String representing the fallback move if required

    • expandStepOneMaxEdge

      public String expandStepOneMaxEdge(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Used only in the first step of the game, since the new Fernies do not get placed.

      Places all Fernies taken from the strongest node at the edge of the visibility range and distributes one Fernie on each visible neutral nodes.

      Fallback moves are applied for all previously taken Fernies that were not placed.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the expansion action and a move String representing the fallback move if required

    • expandStepOneAggressive

      public String expandStepOneAggressive(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Used usually only in the first step of the game, but could also be used in other steps.

      Distributes the new Fernies and Fernies from the strongest node in an aggressive way to all visible neutral (and owned) nodes, in order to occupy neutral nodes in the early game or to stabilize owned nodes. Placement is done symmetrical around the strongest node, whereby more Fernies get placed on the edge nodes of the visibility.

      Fallback moves are applied for all previously taken Fernies that were not placed.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the expansion action and a move String representing the fallback move if required
